sentences.text: This genus contains only one known species, H. gittelmani.
It belongs to the family Mosasauridae, a group of marine reptiles.
Haasiasaurus was one of the oldest known mosasauroids, yet it measured only one meter in length.
Fossils were found in rocks dating from 100 to 93 million years ago near Ein Yabrud, about 20 km north of Jerusalem.
The genus was named in honor of the paleontologist Georg Haas.
The animal lived between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago during the Cenomanian stage.
Researchers suggest the genus might be a chimera because the skull and body parts were not found together.
